arxiv-1802-00180.title: Machine learning and evolutionary techniques in interplanetary trajectory design
arxiv-1802-00180.creator: Dario Izzo, Christopher Sprague, Dharmesh Tailor
arxiv-1802-00180.description: Abstract After providing a brief historical overview on the synergies between artificial intelligence research, in the areas of evolutionary computations and machine learning, and the optimal design of interplanetary trajectories, we propose and study the use of deep artificial neural networks to represent, on-board, the optimal guidance profile of an interplanetary mission.

arxiv-2008-11471.description: Abstract 2DEG states of Al/ δ \delta -GaAs structures were investigated in the persistent tunnelling photoconductivity (PTPC) regime at low temperatures. ”Thickening” of the unoccupied subbands to the ground state of 2DEG was observed at T = 4.2 T=4.2 K K .

arxiv-2104-12260.title: Consistency of invariance-based randomization tests
arxiv-2104-12260.creator: Edgar Dobriban
arxiv-2104-12260.description: Abstract Invariance-based randomization tests—such as permutation tests, rotation tests, or sign changes—are an important and widely used class of statistical methods. They allow drawing inferences under weak assumptions on the data distribution. Most work focuses on their type I error control properties, while their consistency properties are much less understood.

arxiv-2309-07852.title: ExpertQA : Expert-Curated Questions and Attributed Answers
arxiv-2309-07852.creator: Chaitanya Malaviya, Subin Lee, Sihao Chen, Elizabeth Sieber, Mark Yatskar, Dan Roth
arxiv-2309-07852.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chaitanya Malaviya, Subin Lee, Sihao Chen, Elizabeth Sieber, Mark Yatskar, Dan Roth. As language models are adopted by a more sophisticated and diverse set of users, the importance of guaranteeing that they provide factually correct information supported by verifiable sources is critical across fields of study. This is especially the case for high-stakes fields, such as medicine and law, where the risk of propagating false information is high and can lead to undesirable societal consequences.

arxiv-2309-10302.title: Decoupled Training: Return of Frustratingly Easy Multi-Domain Learning
arxiv-2309-10302.creator: Ximei Wang, Junwei Pan, Xingzhuo Guo, Dapeng Liu, Jie Jiang
arxiv-2309-10302.description: Abstract Multi-domain learning (MDL) aims to train a model with minimal average risk across multiple overlapping but non-identical domains. To tackle the challenges of dataset bias and domain domination, numerous MDL approaches have been proposed from the perspectives of seeking commonalities by aligning distributions to reduce domain gap or reserving differences by implementing domain-specific towers, gates, and even experts.

arxiv-2402-19110.title: Temporal-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Energy Storage Bidding in Energy and Contingency Reserve Markets
arxiv-2402-19110.creator: Jinhao Li, Changlong Wang, Yanru Zhang, Hao Wang
arxiv-2402-19110.description: Abstract The battery energy storage system (BESS) has immense potential for enhancing grid reliability and security through its participation in the electricity market. BESS often seeks various revenue streams by taking part in multiple markets to unlock its full potential, but effective algorithms for joint-market participation under price uncertainties are insufficiently explored in the existing research.

arxiv-2410-07017.title: The ( 1 + 3 ) (1+3) -dimensional ‘quantum principle of relativity’ is Einstein’s principle of relativity
arxiv-2410-07017.creator: Matthew J. Lake
arxiv-2410-07017.description: Abstract We show that the ( 1 + 3 ) (1+3) -dimensional ‘superboost’ operators, proposed in Dragan and Ekert’s most recent work on superluminal reference frames [ 1 ] , are simply the canonical Lorentz boosts, expressed in nonstandard notation.

arxiv-2412-09022.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Solving Contact Problems in Three Dimensions
arxiv-2412-09022.creator: Tarik Sahin \orcidID 0000-0002-4134-3726, Daniel Wolff \orcidID 0000-0001-5767-7803 and Alexander Popp \orcidID 0000-0002-8820-466X
arxiv-2412-09022.description: Abstract This paper explores the application of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to tackle forward problems in 3D contact mechanics, focusing on small deformation elasticity. We utilize a mixed-variable formulation, enhanced with output transformations, to enforce Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions as hard constraints.

arxiv-2510-10892.title: Observability and parameter estimation of a generic model for aggregated distributed energy resources
arxiv-2510-10892.creator: Bukunmi G. Odunlami, Marcos Netto
arxiv-2510-10892.description: Abstract We propose a novel framework for estimating the parameters of an aggregated distributed energy resources ( der_a ) model. First, we introduce a rigorous method to determine whether all model parameters are estimable. When they are not, our approach identifies the subset of parameters that can be estimated.

pmc-10537418.title: Recent Synthetic Advances on the Use of Diazo Compounds Catalyzed by Metalloporphyrins
pmc-10537418.creator: Mário M Q Simões, José A S Cavaleiro, Vitor F Ferreira, Lei Zhou
pmc-10537418.description: Diazo compounds are organic substances that are often used as precursors in organic synthesis like cyclization reactions, olefinations, cyclopropanations, cyclopropenations, rearrangements, and carbene or metallocarbene insertions into C−H, N−H, O−H, S−H, and Si−H bonds. Typically, reactions from diazo compounds are catalyzed by transition metals with various ligands that modulate the capacity and selectivity of the catalyst.

pmc-11495104.title: Co-delivery of polyphyllin II and IR780 PLGA nanoparticles induced pyroptosis combined with photothermal to enhance hepatocellular carcinoma immunotherapy
pmc-11495104.creator: Huating Huang, Jing Fu, Hulinyue Peng, Yuanyuan He, Aqian Chang, Huizhong Zhang, Yang Hao, Xiaohan Xu, Shiman Li, Jingxia Zhao, Jian Ni, Xiaoxv Dong
pmc-11495104.description: The clinical efficacy of immunotherapy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is significantly limited by the low immunogenicity of the tumor. Recent studies have revealed that both pyroptosis and photothermal therapy can effectively induce tumor immunogenic cell death (ICD) in liver cancer cells.

pmc-12651699.title: Hybrid Faster R-CNN for Tooth Numbering in Periapical Radiographs Based on Fédération Dentaire Internationale System
pmc-12651699.creator: Yong-Shao Su, I Elizabeth Cha, Yi-Cheng Mao, Li-Hsin Chang, Zi-Chun Kao, Shun-Yuan Tien, Yuan-Jin Lin, Shih-Lun Chen, Kuo-Chen Li, Patricia Angela R Abu, Ghazanfar Latif, Jaafar Alghazo
pmc-12651699.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Tooth numbering is essential because it allows dental clinicians to identify lesion locations during diagnosis, typically using the Fédération Dentaire Internationale system. However, accurate tooth numbering is challenging due to variations in periapical radiograph (PA) angles. In this study, we aimed to develop a deep learning-based tool to assist dentists in accurately identifying teeth via tooth numbering and improve diagnostic efficiency and accuracy.

pmc-12743574.title: Parsimonious Logistic Regression Models for 90-Day Mortality Prediction in the Intensive Care Unit
pmc-12743574.creator: Sadiq A Olayinka
pmc-12743574.description: IntroductionEarly identification of critically ill patients is essential in intensive care units to guide triage and allocate resources. To support these decisions, prognostic scoring systems are commonly used to estimate illness severity and predict outcomes. The Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II (APACHE II) and the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) are among the most widely used.

pmc-12895257.title: Prevalence of the Metabolic Syndrome and its Associated Factors among Hospital Workers at a Rwandan Provincial Hospital: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12895257.creator: James Gafirita, Cuthbert Musarurwa, David Tumusiime, Stephen Rulisa, Mediatrice Mukahigiro, Charlotte Munganyinka Bavuma, Evariste Ntaganda, Laetitia Twizelimana, Marie Louise Nshimiyimana, Marguerite Uwimana, Joseph Lune Ngenzi, Aime Dieudonne Hirwa
pmc-12895257.description: BackgroundThe metabolic syndrome (MetS) is a cluster of interconnected risk factors, affecting approximately 20–30% of the adult population worldwide, with a rising burden in sub-Saharan Africa, including Rwanda. Hospital workers, a critical component of the healthcare system, are at risk of developing MetS due to occupational stress, sedentary lifestyle, and poor dietary habits.

pmc-13059029.title: Physiological glomerular filtration rate and responses to Zeitgeber time and cold stress in C57BL/6 mice
pmc-13059029.creator: Xinran Wang, Yanqi Liu, Yu Xin, Hongxu Li, Lifeng Shen, Yu Xiao, Yuchen Song, Linqiong Liu, Kaijiang Yu, Changsong Wang
pmc-13059029.description: Transcutaneous FITC-sinistrin clearance provides a minimally invasive method to measure real-time glomerular filtration rate (GFR) in small animals. However, large-scale physiological reference data and analyses of time-of-day and environmental temperature influences remain limited. We aimed to establish reference values for GFR in healthy C57BL/6 mice and to assess variations related to Zeitgeber timing and cold stress.

pmc-13119602.title: Therapeutic Vaccines for Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
pmc-13119602.creator: Michael Baliton, Duha Alfatlawi, Shirin Attarian, Rupali Nabar, Victoria Villaflor
pmc-13119602.description: Background and Objectives: Recent evidence demonstrates additional survival benefit of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy in the treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCSC) and nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). However, overall outcomes remain relatively stagnant despite this significant progress. Therapeutic vaccines are a promising adjunct to existing systemic therapy strategies in HNSCC and NPC.

pmc-13219539.title: Long-read assembly reveals vast transcriptional complexity in the placenta associated with metabolic and endocrine function
pmc-13219539.creator: Sean T. Bresnahan, Hannah E. J. Yong, Aryun Nemani, William H. Wu, Sierra Lopez, Jerry Kok Yen Chan, Frédérique White, Pierre-Étienne Jacques, Marie-France Hivert, Shiao-Yng Chan, Michael I. Love, Jonathan Y. Huang, Arjun Bhattacharya
pmc-13219539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The placenta is critical for fetal development and mediates effects of pregnancy complications on offspring metabolic health yet remains poorly characterized in genomic studies. Existing transcriptomic analyses rely on adult tissue reference annotations, overlooking developmentally important splicing diversity. Using largest-in-class long-read RNA-seq (n = 72), we create a comprehensive placental transcriptome reference identifying 37,661 high-confidence isoforms (14,985 previously unannotated) across 12,302 genes (2,759 previously unannotated).

pmc-13251489.title: Genetic Screening of Patients With Inherited Fanconi Syndrome
pmc-13251489.creator: Yuta Inoki, Nana Sakakibara, Asahi Yamamoto, Yuka Kimura, Shuhei Aoyama, Atsushi Kondo, Hiroaki Hanafusa, Tomoko Horinouchi, Tomohiko Yamamura, China Nagano, Shingo Ishimori, Shinya Asato, Akihiro Fukuda, Shun Hashimoto, Tsubasa Murase, Koji Nagatani, Izaya Nakaya, Takayuki Okamoto, Shunsuke Takayan
pmc-13251489.description: IntroductionThe clinical and genetic spectrum of inherited Fanconi renotubular syndrome (FRTS) remains incompletely characterized, and the role of recently recognized genes such as GATM has not been systematically assessed.MethodsThis retrospective study included 20 families with FRTS (14 pediatric and 6 adult index cases) who underwent targeted panel sequencing between 2016 and 2024. The variant spectrum and clinical characteristics were evaluated.

pmc-13534409.creator: Paola Muñoz-Laiton, Juan C Hernandez-Valencia, Juan Pablo Isaza, Maisa da S Araújo, Joana Falcão Salles, Margarita M Correa
pmc-13534409.description: Anopheles darlingi is the main malaria vector in the Neotropics. Despite their importance, little is known about the microbiota composition in areas where these vectors are found. Since the microbiota may influence host biology and vector competence, it is essential to understand these microbial communities in endemic regions. This study explores the bacterial and fungal communities in An.

pmc-13678112.title: Refractory Anti‐HMGCR Necrotizing Myopathy With Progressive Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure Responsive to a JAK Inhibitor
pmc-13678112.creator: N Huang, T B George, L Christopher-Stine, A Nicolas, C Oddis, D P Ascherman, V M Liarski, Ankit Dhoundiyal
pmc-13678112.description: Immune‐mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM) associated with 3‐hydroxy‐3‐methylglutaryl‐coenzyme A reductase (HMGCR) antibodies is a rare condition often associated with statin use. It typically presents with proximal weakness and markedly elevated creatine phosphokinase (CPK) levels and is often refractory, requiring long‐term immunotherapy. Respiratory involvement is uncommon but can be life‐threatening.
